note: Internal validation only. Weights and thresholds are initial experimental settings; the published Best Match forecast stays the service forecast.
past_source: published Best Match file dist/data/weather/<region>.json (past_days) + JMA observations where available

transitions.note: 36 h linear blend around the 240/241 h boundary: w = (1-a)·from + a·to, a = (lead - start + 1)/(end - start + 2). Smooths the model switch only; not an accuracy improvement. Both models must still provide values (missing-model policy applies).

country_profiles.note: Model policy per country. JP = the bands / transitions above (unchanged). KR = Open-Meteo only (no KMA): Best Match for 0-72 h, ECMWF + GFS, ECMWF, Best Match. Past hours are Open-Meteo model values for both (never shown as observations).

country_detection.note: Same coordinate boxes as the app's home country picker (dist/app.js regionCountry). Outside both boxes -> no multi-model file (the app keeps Best Match). region_country overrides the boxes.

missing_model_policy.rule: renormalize weights over models with a real value at that hour; never treat a missing model as 0

excluded.wind_speed_10m: JMA wind is a 10-min mean at the station anemometer, not the model hourly 10 m value
excluded.snowfall: JMA new snow = positive snow-depth change, not interchangeable with model snowfall

bias.note: Bias learned at a JMA station is applied only to the forecast computed for that same station location and elevation. Ski points (summit/mid/base) have no collocated observation, so no bias is applied there.
